hostname ix-g01
!
ip access-list ACL-G-NAT permit ip src 198.51.100.0/24 dest any
ip access-list ACL-G-WAN permit tcp established src any dest any
ip access-list ACL-G-WAN permit tcp src any dest 203.0.113.1/32 dport eq 80
ip access-list ACL-G-WAN permit udp src any sport eq 53 dest any dport range 1024 65535
ip access-list ACL-G-WAN permit icmp echo-reply src any dest any
ip access-list ACL-G-WAN permit icmp type 3 code 4 src any dest any
ip access-list ACL-G-WAN deny ip src any dest any
!
ip route default 203.0.113.2
ip route default 203.0.113.3 distance 200
!
watch-group 1 10
  event 10 ip unreach-host 203.0.113.2 source GigaEthernet0.0
  probe-counter variance 6
  probe-timer variance 10
  action 10 ip shutdown-route 0.0.0.0/0 203.0.113.2
!
network-monitor 1 enable
!
ip dhcp enable
!
ip dhcp profile POOL-G-LAN
  default-gateway 198.51.100.1
  lease-time 5400
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  description sample wan
  ip address 203.0.113.1/27
  ip filter ACL-G-WAN 1 in
  ip napt enable
  ip napt inside list ACL-G-NAT
  ip napt service nat2 198.51.100.10 8080 tcp 80
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  description sample lan
  ip address 198.51.100.1/24
  ip dhcp binding POOL-G-LAN
  no shutdown
!
